# WeldConstraint2D

- Inherits [`Constraint2D`](constraint2d.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("WeldConstraint2D")`

Holds two parts rigidly together, at the relative position they had when the weld was created. Use it for a sword in a hand, the lid of a crate or the body of a vehicle on its frame.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
